capabilities: Upload the current note to Feishu Docs via command palette, right-click menu, or toolbar
Convert Markdown, images, Mermaid, and YAML to Feishu-compatible format
Set document permissions such as public access, copy, and download after upload
Manage upload history, including re-setting permissions and deleting uploaded documents
Encrypt Feishu credentials locally with AES-GCM 256
disambiguation: Not a two-way vault sync; it uploads notes one-way to Feishu Docs and does not keep devices in sync.
extras: Manifest carries the note 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' Batch upload is not supported due to Feishu space and API call limits; full setup guide is on an external page; public links are subject to Feishu's content policies.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish a note to Feishu Docs as a shareable cloud document with link permissions.

relations.evidence: 调用飞书api接口、上传到飞书服务器

requires.name: Feishu App ID and App Secret

summary: Uploads Obsidian notes as Feishu cloud documents with format conversion, image handling, permission controls, and an upload history.
